_about: Operator-marked ground truth for the Part-2 chart-reading exercise (screenshots: Desktop/Stock Images/Part 2). Dates ISO. source: 'operator' = the operator's own dissection (authoritative), 'extraction' = pixel-read from the screenshot (operator has not corrected it). This corpus is the acceptance set for chart-reading upgrades: any reading change is graded by whether the engine surfaces each setup during its LPS window / by its trigger. Last Supper (operator-defined 2026-07-09): the final run-up that traps late buyers before the real pullback; variants can appear BEFORE or AFTER the LPS, and some setups launch directly off it.
